acceptance_tests: TEST-002: DRC clean against generic_two_layer - 0 errors, 0 warnings.
TEST-003: 3.3 V rail within +/-5 % at 500 mA load from 5 V VBUS.
TEST-004: TMP102 responds at I2C address 0x48 and reads within +/-2 degC of reference.
constraints: Logic rail fixed at 3.3 V; no other logic voltage domains permitted (PWR-002).
Two copper layers maximum, generic_two_layer manufacturer profile (MECH-003).
Board outline fixed at 110 x 65 mm, area 35,35 to 145,100 (MECH-001, MECH-002).

OPEN CONFLICT: specification requests USB-C power but pin table provides Connector:USB_B_Micro (J1); requirement IF-004 assumes J1 is replaced with a USB-C receptacle. If J1 must stay USB Micro-B, PWR-001/IF-004 need sign-off before power and layout stages proceed.
+3V3 has no power source in the current design; a regulator with a power_out pin is mandatory (PWR-004).
U2.5 (ADD0) is wrongly on the GND net and must be re-assigned to an address-select net (IF-003, PWR-005).

interfaces.type: I2C (TMP102 temperature sensor, 400 kHz fast mode)

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), regulated on-board to 3.3 V

requirements.statement: Board is powered from a USB-C receptacle supplying VBUS at nominal 5 V (4.75-5.25 V).
All logic and sensor supply rails operate at 3.3 V, regulated down from VBUS.

requirements.source: ESP32-WROOM-32 peak current + USB default sink budget
requirements.statement: Total board current draw from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA, sized for ESP32-WROOM-32 Wi-Fi TX peaks.

requirements.source: pin table: J1.1 VBUS unconnected, +3V3 net has no driver
requirements.statement: The 3.3 V rail requires a real regulator with a power_out driver plus one bulk capacitor (>=10 uF) and one 100 nF decoupling capacitor per supply pin; +3V3 currently has no source and PWR_FLAG symbols must be attached to VBUS and +3V3.

requirements.source: nets: GND includes U2.5 ADD0 in error
requirements.statement: GND is a single common return net tying J1.4, U1.2, U2.2 and the regulator ground; U2.5 (ADD0) shall not be used as a ground connection.
One I2C bus at 3.3 V logic connects U1.GPIO21 (SDA) and U1.GPIO22 (SCL) to U2.SDA/U2.SCL, carrying exactly one sensor device (TMP102).
I2C bus runs at 400 kHz maximum (fast mode) with 4.7 kOhm pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL to the 3.3 V rail.

requirements.source: pin table: U2.5 ADD0 on GND net
requirements.statement: TMP102 ADD0 is tied to a defined logic level via a dedicated net to select I2C address 0x48, not left on GND by accident.

requirements.source: conflict: request says USB-C, pin table shows USB_B_Micro
requirements.statement: Connector J1 is currently Connector:USB_B_Micro, which conflicts with the USB-C requirement; J1 shall be replaced with a USB-C receptacle including 5.1 kOhm CC1/CC2 pull-down resistors at 5 V VBUS.
USB data pair (USB_D+/USB_D-) is routed as a 90 ohm differential pair at 3.3 V signalling between J1 and U1.
U1.EN is driven through a reset RC network (10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V plus 100 nF to GND) instead of being tied directly to +3V3.
Board outline is fixed at 110 mm wide (X from 35 to 145 mm).
Board outline is fixed at 65 mm high (Y from 35 to 100 mm).

requirements.source: request: stay within a two-layer board; manufacturer_profile generic_two_layer
requirements.statement: Stackup is limited to 2 copper layers per the generic_two_layer manufacturer profile, with a layer-2 ground return under the I2C and USB nets, >=0.2 mm copper-to-edge clearance and no courtyard overlap.
ERC reports zero errors and zero warnings (baseline 10 errors / 8 warnings).
DRC reports zero errors and zero warnings against the generic_two_layer profile (baseline 6 errors / 14 warnings).
Measured 3.3 V rail is within +/-5 % of nominal with USB-C VBUS at 5 V under full 500 mA load.
TMP102 is readable at I2C address 0x48 and returns temperature within +/-2 degC of a reference over the operating range.
